title: Convex Combination of Simplex Points
body_html:
Convex Combination of Simplex Points

The basic vocabulary for blending two mixed strategies. Given $x, y \in \Delta(I)$ and $\alpha \in [0, 1]$, the mixed point

$$ \mathrm{mix}(\alpha; x, y) \;=\; \alpha \cdot x + (1 - \alpha) \cdot y $$

is again a simplex point. This is the substrate for compound lotteries (MSZ Axiom 2.16), the inductive perturbation step in Loomis-style minimax proofs, and any algorithm that interpolates between two distributions (fictitious play, no-regret dynamics, Sion-style continuity arguments).

Statement

For a finite index I, a strictly ordered field 𝕜, and α ∈ [0, 1]:

  • stdSimplex.mix α hα₀ hα₁ x y is the element of stdSimplex 𝕜 I whose i-th coordinate is $\alpha \cdot x_i + (1 - \alpha) \cdot y_i$.
  • Bilinearity of wsum (wsum_mix): for any f : I → 𝕜, $$ \operatorname{wsum}(\mathrm{mix}(\alpha; x, y), f) \;=\; \alpha \cdot \operatorname{wsum}(x, f) + (1 - \alpha) \cdot \operatorname{wsum}(y, f). $$
  • Strict-monotonicity over a convex combination (linear_comb_gt_of_ge_gt, linear_comb_lt_of_le_lt, and their wsum versions wsum_mix_gt_of_ge_gt and wsum_mix_lt_of_le_lt): if one endpoint of the combination satisfies a non-strict bound and the other a strict bound, the combination remains strict for any α < 1.
  • Neighborhood-of-1 existential (mix_gt_of_gt_nbh and dual mix_lt_of_lt_nbh): if c < x, there is an interior t ∈ (0, 1) with c < t · x + (1 - t) · y. The proof appeals to continuity of $s \mapsto s \cdot x + (1 - s) \cdot y$ at $s = 1$.

Hypothesis convention

Hypotheses for α are passed as plain (α : 𝕜) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α ≤ 1) rather than via a unit-interval subtype, matching Mathlib idioms and avoiding a Core-level subtype declaration that would not pay for itself. The legacy Interval := { t : ℝ // 0 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 1 } subtype, previously defined in StrategicGame/MinimaxLoomis.lean, has been retired in favor of this convention.

Use

  • EconCSLib.Utility.Lottery: Lottery.mix is a definitional alias of stdSimplex.mix; Lottery.expectedValue_mix is a one-line wrapper around wsum_mix.
  • EconCSLib.StrategicGame.MinimaxLoomis (simplified Loomis induction) and EconCSLib.StrategicGame.LoomisGeneral (general-B Loomis): the inductive step "blend the existing optimiser with the optimiser of the smaller restricted game" is the canonical consumer of stdSimplex.mix, wsum_mix, wsum_mix_*_of_*, and mix_*_nbh.

References

  • [MSZ] Maschler, Solan, Zamir, Game Theory, Axiom 2.16 and the surrounding discussion of compound lotteries.
  • [MFoGT] Laraki, Renault, Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, Section 2.5 (Loomis induction).

deps.title: Weighted Sum over the Standard Simplex

lean_refs.name: stdSimplex.mix
lean_refs.signature:
def stdSimplex.mix (α : 𝕜) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α ≤ 1)
    (x y : stdSimplex 𝕜 I) : stdSimplex 𝕜 I where

lean_refs.name: stdSimplex.mix_apply
lean_refs.signature:
theorem stdSimplex.mix_apply (α : 𝕜) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α ≤ 1)
    (x y : stdSimplex 𝕜 I) (i : I) :
    (stdSimplex.mix α hα₀ hα₁ x y).val i = α * x.val i + (1 - α) * y.val i

lean_refs.name: wsum_mix
lean_refs.signature:
theorem wsum_mix (α : 𝕜) (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α ≤ 1)
    (x y : stdSimplex 𝕜 I) (f : I → 𝕜) :
    wsum (stdSimplex.mix α hα₀ hα₁ x y) f =
      α * wsum x f + (1 - α) * wsum y f

lean_refs.name: linear_comb_gt_left
lean_refs.signature:
theorem linear_comb_gt_left {x y : ℝ} (H : x < y) {α : ℝ} (Hα : α < 1) :
    x < α * x + (1 - α) * y

lean_refs.name: linear_comb_gt_right
lean_refs.signature:
theorem linear_comb_gt_right {x y : ℝ} (H : y < x) {α : ℝ} (Hα : 0 < α) :
    y < α * x + (1 - α) * y
lean_refs.docstring: If `y < x` and `0 < α`, then `α·x + (1-α)·y > y`.

lean_refs.name: linear_comb_gt_of_ge_gt
lean_refs.signature:
theorem linear_comb_gt_of_ge_gt (x y c : ℝ) (H1 : c ≤ x) (H2 : c < y)
    {α : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α < 1) :
    c < α * x + (1 - α) * y
lean_refs.docstring: Convex combination of "≥ c" and "> c" stays "> c" (provided `α ≥ 0` and `α < 1`).

lean_refs.name: linear_comb_lt_of_le_lt
lean_refs.signature:
theorem linear_comb_lt_of_le_lt (x y c : ℝ) (H1 : x ≤ c) (H2 : y < c)
    {α : ℝ} (hα₀ : 0 ≤ α) (hα₁ : α < 1) :
    α * x + (1 - α) * y < c
lean_refs.docstring: Convex combination of "≤ c" and "< c" stays "< c" (provided `α ≥ 0` and `α < 1`).

lean_refs.name: wsum_mix_gt_of_ge_gt
lean_refs.signature:
theorem wsum_mix_gt_of_ge_gt {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (f : α → ℝ) (x y : stdSimplex ℝ α) (c : ℝ)
    (H1 : c ≤ wsum x f) (H2 : c < wsum y f)
    {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1) (Ht : t < 1) :
    c < wsum (stdSimplex.mix t ht₀ ht₁ x y) f

lean_refs.name: wsum_mix_lt_of_le_lt
lean_refs.signature:
theorem wsum_mix_lt_of_le_lt {α : Type*} [Fintype α]
    (f : α → ℝ) (x y : stdSimplex ℝ α) (c : ℝ)
    (H1 : wsum x f ≤ c) (H2 : wsum y f < c)
    {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 0 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 1) (Ht : t < 1) :
    wsum (stdSimplex.mix t ht₀ ht₁ x y) f < c

lean_refs.name: mix_gt_of_gt_nbh
lean_refs.signature:
theorem mix_gt_of_gt_nbh (x y c : ℝ) (H : c < x) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < 1 ∧ c < t * x + (1 - t) * y

lean_refs.name: mix_lt_of_lt_nbh
lean_refs.signature:
theorem mix_lt_of_lt_nbh (x y c : ℝ) (H : x < c) :
    ∃ t : ℝ, 0 < t ∧ t < 1 ∧ t * x + (1 - t) * y < c
lean_refs.docstring: Dual: strictly interior `t` keeping `t·x + (1-t)·y < c`, given `x < c`.
